scope: Actual publisher-native standalone d3-edge CPU replay of exactly two previously exposed and audited public initial-state requests. No browser rollout or training.

native_policy.all_heads_policy: All original requested heads and candidates, including inactive targets and singletons; no pruning, hierarchy or operation-first.
native_policy.confidence_semantics: Raw native confidence is normalized entropy confidence. Normalized response confidence is the selected probability; both full responses are retained.

controller_error.message: mandatory CPU request failed or exceeded budget; all actual responses retained

process_result.budget_policy: One cooperative20s timer per full request includes parse/preflight/checkpoints/native forward. Late actual raw output, normalization, selected operation and all costs are retained before failure. No hard cancellation. No HTTP transport is used in this standalone replay.

cases.usd_cost_reason: publisher local CPU has no configured dollar rate; not assumed free

error.message: CPU real-state cooperative20s budget exceeded; no hard cancellation

selected_action.unused_heads_policy: evaluated by native full-head baseline; outputs retained

memory_and_gate_evidence.scope: Unique per-stage JSON files plus append/fsync ledger match every source-declared gate; no independent process/syscall hook was collected.

independent_audit.input_authentication_scope: each named input authenticated at read time; no stable-at-exit claim
independent_audit.prompt_reconstruction: All7 saved prompt strings reconstructed byte-for-byte from pinned native format and raw state/questions; each full saved ID sequence independently reproduced by CPU tokenizers with truncation/padding disabled.
evidence_limits: Saved unique gate files/ledger match all source-declared stages; no independent process or syscall hook traced the worker.
Two public system_one calls and seven native rows are source-controlled and supported by saved responses; no independent forward hook trace or logits replay.
CPU/BF16/F32/T1/thread2/no CUDA initialization are source guards and saved provenance; CUDA13.0 is build metadata, not evidence of GPU execution. No independent GPU utilization/syscall trace.
Current CPU tokenizers0.23.3 and cached tokenizer independently reproduce all saved IDs. Its current extension is pinned now; actual worker shared-library execution was not traced.
Independent prompt reconstruction covers these seven text-only native prompts; no image/video behavior was tested.
No browser actions, rollout, task completion/accuracy, held-out generalization, CUDA provider parity, CPU/GPU numerical or speed superiority is established.

boundaries.scope_of_success: Contract validity and NASA request delivery within20s are not task completion or a correct next-action judgment. Both actual operations are BLOCKED.
boundaries.family_status: Only d3-edge has this standalone CPU replay evidence. The five other models remain unlaunched; this small variant does not replace the main model.
boundaries.local_reference_scope: Full raw request/response objects are self-contained here. Large prompt text and token ID arrays remain in exactly pinned ignored local artifacts, with per-head JSON pointers/SHA/lengths above.
